title: Act: Create asset folders with temporary pixel-art files
summary: Add the asset tree and one real file per folder.
description: Add SVG pixel-art assets for background, furniture, objects, a 2-frame boy spritesheet, a dust effect, ui icon, frame and cursor, and a tiny WAV for audio. Mark them temporary in a README.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo, when the folders are listed, then all 9 folders exist
Given each folder, when read, then it has a non-empty file
technical_constraints: Spritesheet boy-sheet.svg is 64x48 with two 32x48 frames

steps.action: Create a 320x180 SVG with a wall rect, a floor rect and a lamp-glow rect using warm colors, shape-rendering crispEdges.
steps.code: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="320" height="180" shape-rendering="crispEdges"><rect width="320" height="110" fill="#6b5b73"/><rect y="110" width="320" height="70" fill="#8a5a3c"/></svg>
